# Files eligible for low-risk auto-approval.
# One glob per line. Lines starting with "!" are denials and always win.
# Keep this list narrow: anything here can be merged with a bot approval only.

# Prose content
website/docs/**/*.md
website/docs/**/*.mdx
website/snippets/**/*.md
website/snippets/**/*.mdx

# Release notes
website/docs/docs/dbt-versions/**/*.md

# Sidebar nav: allowed, but same word/file limits as everything else apply.
# No special-case threshold — a real reorg blows past 30 words anyway.
website/sidebars.js

# Blog promo content: low-risk data files, no build/plugin logic.
website/blog/ctas.yml
website/blog/metadata.yml

# Site config: allowed, but low-risk-check.js additionally requires every
# changed line to sit inside the announcementBar block. Anything else in this
# file (plugins, build, nav) still fails the check even though it's listed here.
website/docusaurus.config.js

# Never auto-approve these, even if a glob above matches
!.github/**
!website/src/**
!website/static/**
!website/scripts/**
!website/*.ts
!website/*.json
!website/constants.js
!website/cypress.config.js
!website/jest.setup.js
!website/webpack.config.js
!website/dbt-versions.js
!website/vercel.json
!styles/**
!**/package.json
!**/package-lock.json
